name: slo-design
description: Design and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for production services. Covers SLI selection, SLO target-setting, error budget calculation, burn-rate alerting, and error budget policy. Use when asked about "SLO", "SLI", "error budget", "reliability targets", "burn rate", "uptime SLA", or when designing alerting for a production service. Do NOT use for: application-level performance optimization — use `web-performance` for frontend.
